overview: You tried the Friar's cell at first light. Every character on the sheet had gone irritable, the Friar most of all. You wrote one bad line, struck it with ten more, and kept none of the eleven.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the line, struck the eleven, and left the sheet as a block of strokes.

assets.name: the Friar's cell
assets.disposition: Struck eleven lines in the Friar's cell

important_dates.meaning: Eleven lines, and none of them kept

summary: Struck eleven lines in the Friar's cell
